episodeTitle.en: “I like being scared”: Molly Graham’s frameworks for rapid career growth | Molly Graham
episodeTitle.zh: “我喜欢被吓到”：莫莉·格雷厄姆的快速职业成长框架 | 莫莉·格雷厄姆

guestBioOfficial.en: Molly Graham has worked for some of tech’s most effective leaders, including Mark Zuckerberg, Sheryl Sandberg, Chamath Palihapitiya, and Bret Taylor. Today she leads Glue Club, a community for leaders navigating rapid scale, growth, and change. She’s best known for her “Give away your Legos” framework and her collection of practical mental models for leading through hypergrowth. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆曾为马克·扎克伯格、谢丽尔·桑德伯格、查马斯·帕利哈皮蒂亚和布雷特·泰勒等科技界最具影响力的领导者工作过。如今，她领导着Glue Club——一个为应对快速扩张、增长和变革的领导者提供支持的社区。她最著名的作品是“Give away your Legos”框架，以及她为在超增长环境中领导团队而收集的实用思维模型。*我们讨论：*

title.en: “I like being scared”: Molly Graham’s frameworks for rapid career growth | Molly Graham
title.zh: “我喜欢被吓到”：莫莉·格雷厄姆的快速职业成长框架 | 莫莉·格雷厄姆

summary.en: Molly argues that ~80% of company culture is defined by the founder's personality, and leaders must articulate and scale it deliberately. She introduces "giving away your Legos" - letting go of what you're good at to take on new challenges as the company grows. The episode also covers the J-curve versus stairs model of career risk and growth.
summary.zh: 莫莉认为，约 80% 的公司文化由创始人的个性决定，领导者必须有意识地去阐释并放大它。她提出"交出你的乐高"——在公司成长时，放下你擅长的事，去迎接新挑战。本期还涵盖了职业风险与成长的"J 曲线 vs 阶梯"模型。
